status.summary: Free agent, not under UFC contract; no title or ranking. His last MMA bout was a loss to Mike Perry on Most Valuable Promotions' MVP MMA 1 'Rousey vs. Carano' card (May 16, 2026, Intuit Dome, Inglewood; Netflix): his cutman Jacob 'Stitch' Duran had it stopped after round 2 because of cuts (TKO, corner stoppage, 5:00 of R2; referee Mike Beltran per Sherdog). He needed 15 staples and 20 stitches, mostly for a gash on the right side of his forehead, and broke a finger in the fight. It was his first MMA fight since UFC 279 (Sep 10, 2022), where his round-4 guillotine of Tony Ferguson completed his UFC contract. In between he boxed twice: a unanimous-decision loss to Jake Paul (Aug 5, 2023) and a majority-decision win over Jorge Masvidal (Jul 6, 2024) (Wikipedia). He brushed off retirement talk after the Perry loss, and in Sep 2026 said he would fight 'everywhere', including MMA in a ring, but nothing is booked as of Nov 6, 2026 (UFCalendar). Pro MMA record 21-14 (Sherdog, Wikipedia, UFCalendar). Age 41.

injuries.what: Cuts, chiefly a gash on the right side of the forehead, closed with 15 staples and 20 stitches combined, plus a broken finger, in the May 16, 2026 loss to Mike Perry. No later medical update found.

signature: constant southpaw jab-straight volume: 4.6 significant strikes landed per minute (lightweight median 4.1) plus heavy non-significant volume, 7.4 total strikes landed per minute (fighters.json career)
close-range punching in the clinch: 22% of his landed significant strikes come in the clinch; 77 clinch strikes landed vs Conor McGregor at UFC 202
guillotine from bottom: finished Tony Ferguson (UFC 279, R4), Melvin Guillard and Junior Assuncao from guard or half guard, and Jim Miller after a drop to the ground (UFC Stats)
triangles and armbar off his back (Alvin Robinson, Kurt Pellegrino, Takanori Gomi) and the rear-naked choke that finished McGregor at UFC 196 (UFC Stats)
late-round surges: 31 significant strikes in round 5 vs Leon Edwards at UFC 263, his best round of that fight; 49 in round 3 vs McGregor at UFC 202
weaknesses: leg kicks: opponents land 25% of their significant strikes on his legs (league lightweight about 15%); McGregor 40 of 45 at UFC 202, Ferguson 34 of 39 at UFC 279, Edwards 23 of 23 at UFC 263
weak takedown defence: 44% career (lightweight median 67%); Benson Henderson held him down for 16:58 (2012) and opponents controlled him for 29% of his UFC minutes
cuts: his loss to Masvidal at UFC 244 was a doctor stoppage for facial cuts after round 3
little one-punch power: 0.18 knockdowns per 15 min (lightweight median 0.31) and only 2 KO/TKO wins in 27 UFC fights
age and decline: 41, and stopped on his corner's call after round 2 by Mike Perry (May 16, 2026, MVP card, Sherdog) in his first MMA fight in more than three and a half years
style.summary: A long-armed southpaw who walks opponents down behind a busy jab and left straight, keeps punching in the clinch and gets stronger as the fight goes on. Off his back he is a dangerous Cesar Gracie-trained grappler with guillotines, triangles and chokes; ten of his 16 UFC wins are submissions. He was hard to stop in the UFC (one KO loss by strikes in 27 fights), though his corner pulled him after round 2 against Mike Perry in May 2026 at age 41, and he gives up leg kicks, takedowns and cuts.

moves.notes: Group weights (head, body, leg) each sum to 1; the engine's target split should come from fighters.json. Career significant attempts go head 0.835 / body 0.115 / leg 0.051 and landed head 0.742 / body 0.170 / leg 0.087; recency-weighted attempts are 0.816 / 0.134 / 0.050. League lightweight attempts are about 0.77 / 0.15 / 0.09, so he is more head-heavy and kicks far less than average. In the head group the jab and left straight lead because his output is mostly straight punching at range (73% of his landed significant strikes are at distance, career) with a lot of extra non-significant volume (7.4 total vs 4.6 significant landed per minute). Head kicks are rare (0.02). The body group leans on punches: 22% of his landed strikes come in the clinch and his body strikes cluster in close exchanges (50 body strikes landed vs McGregor at UFC 202, with 77 clinch strikes), so bodyhook and bodystraight outweigh bodykick. Leg strikes are only 5% of attempts; the calf/inside split is a judgment with low confidence. Spinning is 0. Knee and elbow are small and judged from his clinch share. UFC Stats does not record technique types, so the within-group split is an analyst judgment from the bout stats in data/raw, not a published breakdown.

engine_notes.note: Output rises through the fight. Five-round pace relative to round 1 is 1.00 / 1.38 / 1.06 / 1.21 / 1.00, and the three-round curve is 1.00 / 1.18 / 1.37. Edwards (UFC 263) is the example: 10, 13, 3, 19 and 31 significant strikes landed by round.

Submission threat off his back is far above average: 1.16 attempts per 15 min career (lightweight median 0.28, league 0.42) and 10 submission wins, five of them guillotines. A takedown by the opponent should not be treated as a safe position against him.

Low knockdown power, high durability: 0.18 knockdowns scored per 15 min vs a median of 0.31, and one KO loss by strikes (Josh Thomson head kick, 2013) in 27 UFC fights, despite 9 knockdowns absorbed. Outside the UFC, his corner stopped his May 16, 2026 fight with Mike Perry after round 2.

Leg-kick and takedown vulnerability: opponents' landed significant strikes go 57% head / 18% body / 25% legs against him, and he stops only 44% of takedowns. Opponents with a kicking game or wrestling should get a bonus.
Division: fighters.json files him at lightweight (career-most), but his last five UFC fights (2016-2022) were all at welterweight. For a current matchup use 170 lb.

Current form: his only MMA bout since Sep 10, 2022 is the corner-stoppage loss to Mike Perry outside the UFC (May 16, 2026), which has no stats in the UFC data and left him with 15 staples, 20 stitches and a broken finger. Apply an age (41) and decline discount, and a cut-risk bump, for a current version; use the career sums for a prime version.
